fairness.binary_global_replan_note: At a native chunk boundary a value-only global replan collapses to the same selection as value-only unless it consumes an additional query; additional-query cost is reported separately and is never treated as a free benefit.

gate_contract.d25: all 80 candidate pools collected once and audited; no pool membership changes after outcomes
gate_contract.d26: separate generator coverage, attribution routing, dependency gating and extra-query effects
gate_contract.d27: all five arms run from the same frozen candidate pools and budgets
gate_contract.d28: development mechanism trend may pass only with positive task-level signal and zero paired harm; independent attribution Gate M2 remains a separate prerequisite for the main experiment

rules: No task, state, condition, K, shift, budget, threshold or method is changed after candidate outcomes are observed.
The D18-v18i attribution model and D20-v10 utility model remain frozen.
Ground-truth condition and candidate outcomes are unavailable to learned selector arms.
Outcome oracle is reported only as a post-outcome ceiling and is not a deployable arm.
A pool with zero successful candidates remains in every overall denominator.
D21 independent 0/6 candidate coverage remains a separate negative result.
